intermediate_problem.reason: The source supplies pigment-presence coarse semantics and four native pigment-pattern codes, but no privileged intermediate grouping. Grouping DOUBLE_PIGMENTED with ANTHOCYANIN versus YELLOW would be an analyst choice, not a source-defined hierarchy.
intermediate_problem.observed_frame_collapse: State 3 is absent from both the monomorphic primary and polymorphic sensitivity exact joins, so any such three-category intermediate grouping reduces to the same observed 0/1/2 partition as the source-native fine coding.

why_verbatim_colour_text_is_not_promoted: Exact taxonomic colour-description strings are provenance text with heterogeneous wording and citations. Treating literal strings or post-hoc normalized text as biological fine states would introduce an analyst-defined observation-language resolution rather than a source-defined pigment hierarchy.
scientific_interpretation: Schema applicability hold only; the existing conditional Antirrhineae fine-state result remains valid for its different conditional-null estimand.
